description: Fork of exp575 (E=192/d_v=32 no_resid + tied dot). ADD: (a) ONE final_residual_lut after layer 6 (NOT per-layer like exp567) projecting E=192 -> D=192, NAP=6 tph=128. (b) ln_final_d = LayerNorm(D). (c) Linear(D, V) unembedder in PARALLEL with the existing tied dot head. Final logits = tied_dot(E-stream) + Linear(post-LUT D-stream). Tests whether a SINGLE final LUT projection + linear head can recover what exp567's full per-layer residual_lut + Linear head pair provided (~0.08 bpb advantage over minimal arch). If yes, this is a cheaper alternative to full per-layer residual_lut. If no, next probe is full per-layer residual restoration. Predicted +7.86M params (1.57M final_resid_lut + 6.29M Linear) -> ~132M total. Predicted +202 Mbits/tok bandwidth (~1 final_resid + ~201 Linear D=192*V*32) -> ~491 Mbits total. D=192=E (symmetric). Refs: exp567 1.4768 @103M/475 (full arch, untied), exp575 projected 1.53-1.56 @124M/289 (minimal), exp581 projected ~1.51 @230M/540 (minimal E=384), exp328 tied vanilla 1.3882 @23M/742.
